entries.question: Justification of $A_\mu=0$ for the vacuum states in the Higgs mechanism and its consequences?
entries.heat: physics.SE 2026-10-01, 3 points, 2 answers, 102 views (SE API 2026-10-04 复核)
entries.answer_md: **Setting a gauge field to zero is a choice of description, not a deletion of the field.** In the Higgs mechanism the Higgs field takes a nonzero vacuum expectation value, the would-be Goldstone modes are absorbed, and the gauge bosons coupled to the broken generators acquire a mass, while the combination that leaves the unbroken electromagnetic U(1) intact stays massless, which is why the photon is massless. Writing A_mu = 0 characterises the electroweak vacuum and picks a gauge such as unitary gauge for expanding around it, so the field still exists and fluctuates and physical results such as masses and cross sections stay gauge invariant. **The consequences of that choice are therefore bookkeeping, not new physics.** The project layer stays fiction: the semi-Dirac mass-nullification setting imagines a tunable gap that can be driven to zero as an engineering knob, which is not a claim about electroweak theory, and the correlated-electron side is developed in the artificial Kondo lattice setting.

entries.question: All existing communication infrastructure has vanished. What technology do we use to rebuild it?
entries.heat: worldbuilding.SE 2026-10-01, -1 points, 2 answers, 136 views (SE API 2026-10-04 复核)
entries.answer_md: **Rebuilding communications starts with radio, because it is the only channel that needs no fixed infrastructure.** Ionospheric HF skywave carries beyond the horizon with modest power, VHF and UHF are limited to line of sight, and satellites give the fastest wide-area coverage at the cost of launch, so the practical order is point-to-point radio, then relay or satellite, then fibre wherever the ground is intact. The physics sets the ceilings: free-space power falls with the square of distance, latency is bounded by the speed of light, and Shannon capacity ties data rate to bandwidth and signal-to-noise rather than to cleverness. Nothing exotic is required and no new physics is needed. The fiction layer is separate: the type-II superlattice perception matrix imagines sensing past the usual wavelength limit, and the field-shaping half of the same idea is in the electromagnetic theater override setting.
